meta.note: Brightwater Retail Ltd is fictional; all data is synthetic.
grain_limits: Weekly net revenue by store is governed for H2 only; three H2 2024 store-weeks have no row (S03 week 28, S17 week 29, S09 week 30: missing targets), so those points are gaps.
No governed table holds weekly revenue by category; the category filter applies to H2 totals.
meta.checks: H2 2025 = 9,457,457.05 and YoY = -7.18% reconciled before export

evidence.what_we_know: Excess robust across 13 control-group and window variants; pre-trend slope p 0.93; placebo p 0.0015 (680 placebo groups); abrupt step (0-day transition) in all three stores within 12 days
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: The cluster was selected in Phase 5 because it declined most, so the placebo p-value (the smallest attainable) overstates significance; no matched control store is in Dublin (the cluster's region), and the Dublin control group has a different format. The cause is not observable

evidence.driver: External / local cause of the cluster loss
evidence.what_we_know: Pattern fits an outside cause: the transaction gap vs controls ranges -30 to -23 pp by weekday, -36 to -22 pp by hour and -32 to -24 pp by category (all strongly negative). Internal levers moved almost like the controls (cluster minus control change): availability +0.04 pp, promo revenue share +1.30 pp, ASP -0.86%, ranged SKUs -0.20%, return rate -0.63 pp
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: No direct evidence; an internal operational change not recorded in the model (e.g. opening hours, store works) would produce the same pattern

evidence.what_we_know: Mechanism visible (no stock, no sales); estimator back-test 0.993; the gross estimate holds across the baseline variants with full coverage
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: After restock, Voltix Distribution Ltd SKUs sold above the expected rate (week 1 after: 1.06x expected, week 2 after: 1.38x expected). Allowing for the prior-year post-restock pattern, sales after episodes with a full-week stock-out ran EUR 13,272 above it: demand deferred rather than lost, which offsets 36% of the gross estimate. Substitution to other SKUs is not measured

evidence.what_we_know: Difference +6.8 pp, 95% CI +2.5 to +11.2, permutation p 0.002 (0.010 after a Bonferroni adjustment for the 4 suppliers, since the supplier was picked as the worst before testing); survives leaving out any single SKU (min +6.1 pp)
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: Other deteriorating groups: Unknown supplier (2 SKUs) -21.8 pp. The data cannot say whether the supplier failed to deliver or Brightwater ordered less

evidence.what_we_know: Top 5 stores hold 89% of the gross increase; 4 of 4 suppliers rose in the significant stores; there the 'Faulty' rate moved +2.84 and all other reasons +0.05 returned units per 100 sold; sale-to-return lag unchanged (KS p 0.60)
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: Spread over many products (top 5 hold only 53%); the till reason is not a verified defect

evidence.what_we_know: In the stores with significant increases, 4 of 4 suppliers rose, while the largest holds 68% of the increase: neither a single-supplier defect nor a store- or distribution-side cause can be excluded
M1 DiD 95% CI -EUR 248,937 to -EUR 121,581; pre-period gap slope +0.0008 log points a week; units -1.7% (CI -4.1% to +0.8%), so the fall is mostly price; M4 discount accounting -EUR 265,003
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: Event-level (M3 EUR 79,059) and dose-response (M2 EUR 97,505) methods say the extra promotions ADDED revenue. Their baselines are exposed to back-to-back promotions (64% of current-year events follow another promotion of the same store-SKU within the baseline window), but the disagreement is real

evidence.what_we_know: Measured SKU by SKU (FACT). New Voltix Distribution Ltd SKUs EUR 252,306 while its continuing SKUs -EUR 210,136: consistent with customers switching to the new models
evidence.what_we_do_not_know: Competing explanations for the continuing-SKU fall: partial-week stock-outs (not in the primary lost-sales estimate), substitution to new SKUs while older ones were out of stock, and switching between models; none can be separated without daily stock and customer-level data

evidence.what_we_know: Closes the exclusive attribution exactly; outside the cluster, categories other than E&T and H&K were flat, so this is not estate-wide softness
